name: python-duckdb-report
title: Python DuckDB report
blurb: Deterministic reports over CSV and Parquet: DECIMAL sums so money is exact, nulls counted instead of dropped, fixed group order, identifiers checked against DESCRIBE before they are interpolated, and a golden-file smoke test
default_description: A reporting CLI over CSV and Parquet files, powered by DuckDB.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --quiet --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --quiet --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: missing-file
verify.cmd: .venv/bin/python -m {{ package_name }} report --data data/nope.csv --group-by region --metric revenue >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -eq 2

verify.name: bad-column
verify.cmd: .venv/bin/python -m {{ package_name }} report --data data/orders.csv --group-by region --metric revenu >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -eq 2

detect.contains: print a report a reviewer can diff
